January 1, 2025

# Tax and Duties are deprecated in Storefront Cart API

DateJanuary 1, 2025

Version[2025-01](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-01)

Flags[Deprecation announcement](https://shopify.dev/changelog?filter=deprecation-announcement)[Action required](https://shopify.dev/changelog?action_required=true)

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[Storefront API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=storefront-graphql)

As of API version `2025-01`, we're deprecating the [tax and duty](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2024-01/objects/Cart#field-cost) fields in Storefront API Cart. Tax and Duties are calculated at Checkout where they can be finalized with the complete context of the buyer's information, ensuring greater accuracy.
